evidence_quotes: geweigerd omgevingsvergunning te verlenen voor de uitbreiding van een horecapand
dat deze uitbreiding in strijd is met het bestemmingsplan.
rationale: This Dutch administrative appeal (RvS) concerns the refusal by the municipal executive of Valkenswaard to grant an environmental/planning permit (omgevingsvergunning) to legalize the expansion of a hospitality building (horecapand) that violated the municipal zoning plan (bestemmingsplan "Dommelen"). It is a standard non-water spatial planning and building permit dispute with no substantive nexus to water law, water governance, or water/sanitation services.
